resources.string: Unknown direction “%1$s”: TD (top to bottom) or BT (bottom to top).
A box or a group has no id.
The id “%1$s” is used twice among the boxes and groups.
Box “%1$s”: its link does not designate a thing of the app.
Box “%1$s” has neither a text nor a link.
An arrow lacks its start or its end.
An arrow names the box “%1$s”, which does not exist.
Group “%1$s” names the box “%2$s”, which does not exist.
Group “%1$s” names the group “%2$s”, which does not exist.
Box “%1$s” is in two groups: “%2$s” and “%3$s”.
Group “%1$s” is in two groups: “%2$s” and “%3$s”.
